recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring two subjects framed within a Kodak Portra 400 film scan border, set against a dark, desaturated, large-scale ghosted background of the same subjects. The composition is punctuated by vibrant red, hand-lettered script.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subjects framed by a distinct analog film border
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a dark, textured environment
Vibrant red script contrasting with a monochromatic and desaturated palette
Scale contrast between the central framed image and the oversized background ghosting
coreInvariants: Hand-written marker-style typography in bright red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central subjects seated, occupying the middle third of the frame within a rectangular border.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central framed photograph with its bright white clothing and jewelry highlights.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central subjects, moves to the red script in the top left, then down to the secondary script in the bottom right, finally expanding to the ghosted background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark, textured negative space surrounding the central frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and silver (clothing and jewelry highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the center; the only high-saturation element is the red text.
paletteRestrictions: Limited palette for the central photo

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight based on speed of stroke
Connected lowercase letters with sharp, aggressive angles
All-caps or mixed-case with a raw, street-art aesthetic

composition.position: top left and bottom right corners of the inner frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style handwritten script used in two different locations for balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, personal feel of the original lettering.
Captures the urban aesthetic and raw energy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, gritty urban portrait of two men with jewelry, framed inside a black Kodak Portra 400 film border. Place this frame on a larger, desaturated, high-contrast ghosted version of the same image with heavy film grain and dust textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-written marker-style text in vibrant red. Place one block of text in the upper left corner tilted slightly, and another block in the lower right corner, ensuring the strokes look like they were drawn with a felt-tip pen.

verificationChecks: Is the film border clearly visible and authentic looking?
Is the red text vibrant and appearing as if hand-drawn?
Is the background sufficiently desaturated and dark?
Do the highlights on the jewelry and clothing pop against the shadows?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the ghosted background image
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the film border text is legible but looks like technical metadata.
Check that the red text does not have a digital drop shadow.
Verify the balance between the central frame and the outer ghosted image.
Confirm the texture feels like a physical scan rather than a digital filter.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central framed photo + Analog film border + Desaturated ghosted background + Red marker script overlay.
